THE CLOSING BELL 🛎️: TODAY'S FULL MARKET RECAP

Here's everything you need to know:

🚨 #1. The Trump administration officially launched “Operation Economic Outcast” today, dramatically expanding its economic campaign against Iran. Treasury sanctioned nearly 60 individuals, companies and vessels tied to Iran while threatening broader secondary sanctions against foreign businesses that continue supporting Iranian shipping, aviation, technology, gold and digital-asset activity. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the goal is to sever every remaining economic lifeline to Tehran, although Washington stopped short of immediately sanctioning major Chinese institutions.

🚨 #2. President Trump escalated the U.S.-Canada trade war again today, announcing that tariffs on cars, trucks, auto parts and steel will rise to 50% beginning January 1, 2027. Trump said companies can avoid the tariffs by building in the U.S., while Canada has already pledged dollar-for-dollar retaliation after trade negotiations collapsed last week. Ford $F fell roughly 3.4% and General Motors $GM declined around 1.1%, while Cleveland-Cliffs $CLF initially surged more than 6%, Nucor $NUE gained roughly 3% and Steel Dynamics $STLD rose nearly 3%. All gains, for the most part, faded by the end of the day.

#3. Iran escalated tensions in the Strait of Hormuz by blacklisting 45 tankers and threatening them with fines, detention and cargo confiscation for allegedly violating its transit rules. The list includes vessels connected to major shipping companies from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, South Korea and elsewhere, and Tehran warned that ships conducting transfers with blacklisted vessels could also face penalties. Roughly 8M barrels of oil per day are currently moving through Hormuz, well below its normal pre-war role in global energy trade.

#4. Semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks sold off sharply ahead of Nvidia $NVDA earnings Wednesday. $NVDA fell 2.9%, SanDisk $SNDK and Seagate $STX dropped about 6.5%, Micron $MU fell roughly 5.8% and Western Digital $WDC lost about 5.2%, helping push the Nasdaq down 0.8%. Part of the pressure came from reports that the Trump administration may allow Apple $AAPL to source memory from Chinese suppliers CXMT and YMTC, creating a potential new competitive threat for U.S. memory producers.

#5. The broader market finished mixed as falling oil prices and lower Treasury yields helped offset the technology selloff. The Dow gained 0.3%🟢, while the S&P 500 fell 0.3%🔴 and the Nasdaq lost 0.8%🔴. The 10-year Treasury yield eased to roughly 4.70% from 4.74% Friday, while WTI crude dropped around 2% to roughly $85 as traders concluded today’s Iran sanctions were not immediately aggressive enough to remove significantly more oil from the global market.

#6. Alibaba $BABA announced a massive $10.2B Hong Kong share sale to fund its escalating AI buildout. The company plans to use the proceeds for AI chips, data-center infrastructure and model development, issuing roughly 710M new shares at an 8.4% discount. $BABA’s Hong Kong shares sold off sharply on the dilution even as management argues that AI could become one of the company’s largest long-term growth engines.

#7. Bitcoin $BTC pushed back toward $79,000 today after gaining more than 20% last week. BTC rose roughly 2% Monday while the iShares Bitcoin Trust $IBIT attracted around $1B of inflows last week, including more than $500M Friday alone. The rally has accelerated since Treasury announced larger long-duration bond buybacks, with investors increasingly treating both Bitcoin and gold as hedges against fiscal deterioration and potential dollar weakness.

#8. PDD Holdings $PDD reported mixed Q2 earnings as the Temu parent continues battling weak Chinese consumption and growing international trade barriers. Revenue rose 8% to RMB112.4B, below roughly RMB116.4B expected, while adjusted EPS of RMB19.33 beat the RMB18.35 consensus. Net income still fell 12% year over year as the company increased spending on logistics, merchants and international operations while Temu absorbs higher U.S. and European trade costs.

#9. Gold $GLD remained above $4,600/oz today after breaking above its 200-day moving average during last week’s surge. Spot gold reached roughly $4,681 intraday before settling near $4,639, while gold ETFs attracted their largest inflows in around 10 months. The metal has increasingly traded as a hedge against Treasury-market stress, fiscal deficits and potential dollar depreciation rather than simply as an inflation trade.

#10. Wednesday and Friday now become the market’s two major decision points. Nvidia $NVDA reports Wednesday with Wall Street expecting roughly $92B in quarterly revenue, while July PCE inflation arrives the same day and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks at Jackson Hole Friday. $NVDA’s report will test whether hyperscaler AI spending can justify current infrastructure valuations, while PCE and Warsh will determine whether the recent move higher in long-term yields develops into a broader rate problem.

There's your market recap for August 24th, 2026

Make sure to follow @OpulentVenture for more! ✅

top_posts.translation_zh:
收盘钟声 🛎️：今日完整市场回顾

以下是你需要了解的一切：

🚨 #1. 特朗普政府今天正式启动“经济弃民行动”（Operation Economic Outcast），大幅扩大其针对伊朗的经济行动。美国财政部制裁了近 60 名与伊朗有关的个人、公司和船只，同时威胁将对继续支持伊朗航运、航空、科技、黄金和数字资产活动的外国企业实施更广泛的次级制裁。美国财政部长 Scott Bessent 表示，目标是切断德黑兰剩余的每一条经济生命线，尽管华盛顿没有立即对主要中国机构实施制裁。

🚨 #2. 特朗普总统今天再次升级美加贸易战，宣布从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，对汽车、卡车、汽车零部件和钢铁的关税将提高至 50%。特朗普表示，企业可以通过在美国建厂来避免这些关税，而加拿大在上周贸易谈判破裂后已经承诺进行一美元对一美元的报复。Ford $F 下跌约 3.4%，General Motors $GM 下跌约 1.1%，而 Cleveland-Cliffs $CLF 盘初一度飙升超过 6%，Nucor $NUE 上涨约 3%，Steel Dynamics $STLD 上涨近 3%。到当天收盘时，所有涨幅基本上都已回落。

#3. 伊朗将 45 艘油轮列入黑名单，并威胁因其涉嫌违反伊朗过境规则而对其处以罚款、扣押和没收货物，从而升级了霍尔木兹海峡的紧张局势。名单包括与阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯、韩国和其他地区大型航运公司有关的船只，德黑兰警告称，与被列入黑名单的船只进行转运的船舶也可能面临处罚。目前每天约有 800 万桶石油通过霍尔木兹海峡，远低于其在战前全球能源贸易中的正常作用。

#4. 在 Nvidia $NVDA 周三发布财报前，半导体和 AI 基础设施股票大幅抛售。$NVDA 下跌 2.9%，SanDisk $SNDK 和 Seagate $STX 下跌约 6.5%，Micron $MU 下跌约 5.8%，Western Digital $WDC 下跌约 5.2%，推动 Nasdaq 下跌 0.8%。部分压力来自一些报道，称特朗普政府可能允许 Apple $AAPL 从中国供应商 CXMT 和 YMTC 采购内存，这可能为美国内存生产商带来新的竞争威胁。

#5. 大盘收盘涨跌不一，油价下跌和美国国债收益率走低帮助抵消了科技股抛售的影响。Dow 上涨 0.3%🟢，而 S&P 500 下跌 0.3%🔴，Nasdaq 下跌 0.8%🔴。10 年期美国国债收益率从周五的 4.74% 回落至约 4.70%，而 WTI 原油下跌约 2%，至约 $85，因为交易员认为今天的伊朗制裁并未立即激进到足以从全球市场上移除显著更多的石油供应。

#6. Alibaba $BABA 宣布在香港进行规模达 $10.2B 的大规模股票出售，以资助其不断升级的 AI 建设。该公司计划将所得资金用于 AI 芯片、数据中心基础设施和模型开发，以 8.4% 的折扣发行约 710M 股新股。尽管管理层认为 AI 可能成为公司最大的长期增长引擎之一，但由于股权稀释，$BABA 的香港股票大幅下跌。

#7. 比特币 $BTC 今天在上周上涨超过 20% 后回升至接近 $79,000。BTC 周一上涨约 2%，与此同时，iShares Bitcoin Trust $IBIT 上周吸引了约 $1B 的资金流入，其中仅周五就超过 $500M。自美国财政部宣布扩大长期债券回购以来，这轮涨势已经加速，投资者越来越多地将比特币和黄金都视为对冲财政恶化和潜在美元走弱的工具。

#8. PDD Holdings $PDD 公布的第二季度财报喜忧参半，这家 Temu 母公司仍在应对中国消费疲软和日益增加的国际贸易壁垒。营收增长 8% 至 RMB112.4B，低于预期的约 RMB116.4B；调整后每股收益为 RMB19.33，高于 RMB18.35 的一致预期。由于公司增加了在物流、商家和国际业务方面的支出，同时 Temu 承担更高的美国和欧洲贸易成本，净利润仍同比下降 12%。

#9. 黄金 $GLD 今天在上周大涨期间突破 200 日移动平均线后，仍维持在 $4,600/oz 上方。现货黄金盘中一度达到约 $4,681，随后收于接近 $4,639；与此同时，黄金 ETF 吸引了约 10 个月以来最大规模的资金流入。黄金越来越多地被作为对冲美国国债市场压力、财政赤字和潜在美元贬值的工具来交易，而不只是单纯的通胀交易。

#10. 周三和周五现在成为市场的两个主要决策点。Nvidia $NVDA 将于周三发布财报，华尔街预计其季度营收约为 $92B；同一天将公布 7 月 PCE 通胀数据，美联储主席 Kevin Warsh 将于周五在 Jackson Hole 发表讲话。$NVDA 的财报将检验超大规模云服务商的 AI 支出是否能支撑当前的基础设施估值，而 PCE 和 Warsh 将决定近期长期收益率上行是否会演变成更广泛的利率问题。

以上就是你 2026 年 8 月 24 日的市场回顾

一定要关注 @OpulentVenture 获取更多内容！✅
